description: Buy a pass for the funding feed: plan "24h" is one $0.250 payment, plan "7d" is one $1.000 payment for 7 days (x402 over MCP, USDC on Base), instead of $0.002 per call. Returns a bearer token (pass it as arguments.pass of funding_rates, or as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on MCP or HTTP requests to GET /v1/funding-rates) plus the current BTC/ETH/SOL funding snapshot. The 24h pass is worth it above about 125 calls a day (every ~12 minutes); the 7-day pass above about 72 calls a day, every day. Fair use: at most one call every 10 seconds; data may be cached up to 20 seconds. If no venue answers, nothing is charged.
name: funding_feed_pass
title: Funding feed pass: 24 hours ($0.250) or 7 days ($1.000)
